findings.message: Sleeping loft has no door or cased opening
Sleeping loft (bedroom): 1.8 m at its narrowest; comfort minimum is 2.4 m (clear floor 3.4 × 1.8 m)
Ladder stair does not sit over itself: its footprints on Ground floor and Sleeping loft do not overlap at all
Ladder stair: 80.5° pitch — 12 risers of 0.217 m over a 0.4 m flight gives a 0.036 m going; 30–42° and a going of 0.25 m upwards is the comfortable range
